analysis.title: Summary: The Science Practitioner
analysis.description: A summary slide featuring a prominent centered title at the top over a light graph-paper background with faint scientific watermark illustrations (light microscope, formula triangle, and electron micrograph). In the center is a large white card with a drop shadow containing four check-marked takeaway statements covering Hardware, Technique, Maths, and Evolution.
analysis.layout: Centered title along the top. Beneath it, a central elevated white card displays four vertically stacked takeaway items, each featuring a blue checkmark icon on the left followed by bold category labels and descriptive text.

components.visibleText: Hardware: We can identify the key components of a light microscope and operate it safely to avoid damaging the slide or lens.
Technique: We know how to prepare a slide, apply stains to reveal colourless tissues, and produce accurate scientific drawings.
Maths: We can confidently use the equation I = A x M and convert units between millimetres and micrometres.
Evolution: We understand that the increased resolution of the electron microscope unlocked our modern understanding of sub-cellular structures.
